mapper.select: SELECT r.id, r.product_id AS productId, r.vip_card_id AS vipCardId, c.card_name AS cardName, r.benefit_price AS benefitPrice, r.created_at AS createdAt, r.updated_at AS updatedAt FROM pt_product_benefit_price r INNER JOIN vip_benefit_card c ON c.vip_card_id = r.vip_card_id WHERE r.product_id = #{productId} ORDER BY r.id ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO pt_product_benefit_price (product_id, vip_card_id, benefit_price, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{productId}, #{vipCardId}, #{benefitPrice}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
